# SQL Patterns: mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live

*Auto-generated by ads-kb-datamap (from-code) -- 30 references (11 write, 19 read)*

## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filter (appears in all queries)
WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- Placement filter for Simple2 ads
AND placement in (50)
AND pricing_type in (15)

-- Placement filter for Discovery ads
AND placement in (2, 5, 802, 805, 1002, 1005, 1202, 1205)

-- Placement filter for Shop Ads
AND placement in (3, 2003, 2030)

-- New Boost detection
AND traffic_source = 4 AND placement in (44, 4400, 4401, 4402, 4405)

-- Event code filter (newer version of workflow)
AND event_code in (1, 11, 15)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 1. JOIN with exchange rate for USD conversion (in write workflow)
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, exchange_rate
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
) exrate
ON a.grass_region = exrate.grass_region

-- 2. JOIN with dim_advertiser for seller type
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live b
ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
-- WHERE b.grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND b.grass_region = upper('${region}') AND b.tz_type = 'local'

-- 3. JOIN with credit topup for credit metadata (in write workflow)
LEFT JOIN manual_credit_tab_temp b
ON a.topup_order_id = b.order_id
  AND a.topup_order_type = b.credit_order_type
  AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND a.credit_topup_type = b.manual_credit_topup_type
  AND a.ads_credit_id <=> b.ads_credit_id

-- 4. JOIN with budget data for hit-budget analysis (read pattern)
JOIN budget_data_tb AS b
ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date
  AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id

-- 5. JOIN with gov_order for credit classification (downstream net revenue)
LEFT JOIN gov_order b
ON a.topup_order_id = b.order_id
  AND a.credit_order_type = b.order_type
  AND a.credit_topup_type = b.credit_topup_type
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 1. Deduction amount aggregation by credit type (net revenue calculation)
SUM(CASE WHEN credit_topup_type IN (1, 2) THEN deduction_amt_usd / (1 + paid_tax_rate) ELSE 0.0 END) AS paid_credit_revenue_usd_1d
SUM(CASE WHEN credit_topup_type IN (3, 4) AND gov_order_type IN ('SCS','SIP','lovito','gov')
    THEN deduction_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END) AS others_free_credit_revenue_usd_1d

-- 2. Hourly pacing (budget hit analysis)
HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(event_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE '{timezone}') AS hh
SUM(deduction_amt_usd) AS cost_usd

-- 3. First/last deduction time per campaign (budget exhaustion detection)
MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_deduction_time
MAX(event_timestamp) AS last_deduction_time
MAX(expected_price_deduction / 100000.00 > deduction_amt) AS budget_or_balance_exhausted

-- 4. Cumulative cost by hour (budget pacing)
SUM(cost_usd) OVER (
    PARTITION BY grass_date, grass_region, placement, ads_id
    ORDER BY hh
) AS cumulative_cost_usd

-- 5. Shop-level max event hour (shop budget suggestion)
HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(event_timestamp))) AS hit_budget_hr
```

### Snippet 1: Net Ads Revenue -- Deduction with Credit Type Breakdown

```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/dws/dws_advertise_net_ads_revenue_1d
SELECT shop_id, ads_id, entrance, placement, pricing_type,
    topup_order_id, credit_order_type, credit_topup_type,
    deduction_amt_usd, sub_entrance, deduction_price_usd,
    voucher_deduction_price_usd, item_id, campaign_id, ab_sign,
    CASE WHEN traffic_source = 4 AND placement IN (44,4400,4401,4402,4405) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_boost
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Snippet 2: Budget Hit Hour Analysis

```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_discovery_ads/manual_tasks/yi.zhangzy/sql/hit_budget_analyze
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, placement, campaign_id, ads_id,
    CASE WHEN grass_region = 'SG' THEN HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(event_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Singapore')
         WHEN grass_region = 'ID' THEN HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(event_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')
         ...
    END AS hh,
    SUM(deduction_amt_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${date_begin}') AND date('${date_end}')
  AND grass_region IN ('BR', 'SG', 'PH')
  AND placement IN (50)
  AND pricing_type IN (15)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
```

### Snippet 3: Discovery Ads Budget Exhaustion Detection

```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_discovery_ads/workflows/xujing_temp/learning_pctr
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, campaign_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_deduction_time,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS last_deduction_time,
    MAX(expected_price_deduction / 100000.00 > deduction_amt) AS budget_or_balance_exhausted
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live a
JOIN campaigns ON a.grass_date = campaigns.grass_date AND a.grass_region = campaigns.grass_region AND a.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
WHERE a.tz_type = 'local'
  AND a.placement IN (2, 5, 802, 805, 1002, 1005, 1202, 1205)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
```

### Snippet 4: Shop Ads Max Click Hour for Budget Suggestion

```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_data/workflows/business_support/shop_ads_budget_suggestion
SELECT grass_region, campaign_id,
    HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(event_timestamp))) AS hit_budget_hr
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${prev2}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('TW','ID','TH','PH','MY','VN','BR','SG')
GROUP BY grass_region, campaign_id
```

### Snippet 5: Write Workflow -- INSERT with Credit Decomposition

```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/workflows/.../dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__*_s0_live
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live
    PARTITION (tz_type = 'local', grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT id, shop_id, user_id, ads_id, campaign_id, placement, ...
    ,deduction_amt
    ,(deduction_amt / exrate.exchange_rate) AS deduction_amt_usd
    ,...
    ,seller_type_1p, seller_type
    ,deduction_price / exrate.exchange_rate AS deduction_price_usd
    ,voucher_deduction_price / exrate.exchange_rate AS voucher_deduction_price_usd
    ,...
FROM union_all_temp a
LEFT OUTER JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live exrate ON ...
LEFT JOIN dim_advertiser b ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
```
